about.title: Head Lacrosse Coach
about.bio: From youth leagues to high school and club competition, I help players develop the stick skills, field vision, and competitive edge that get them on the field and keep them there. My approach builds technically sound, smart players who can compete at the next level.

hero.headline: Cradle. Dodge. Score.
hero.subline: Private lacrosse coaching — stick skills, dodging technique, and game IQ for players who want to elevate their game.

services.title: Stick Skills & Dodging
services.description: Cradling, catching, throwing, and ground balls — plus dodging technique for attackmen, midfielders, and defensemen.

services.title: Shooting & Defense
services.description: Shooting mechanics, shot selection, defensive positioning, and body checking fundamentals for all positions.

services.title: Game IQ & Recruiting Prep
services.description: Film sessions, situational decision-making, and recruiting profile guidance for players targeting college lacrosse.

faq.question: What age groups do you train?
faq.answer: We work with players from 7 years old through college level. Beginners and advanced players both welcome — sessions are skill-matched.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Training takes place at local fields and facilities in the area. Location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: How long are sessions?
faq.answer: 1-on-1 sessions run 60 minutes. Small group sessions are 75–90 minutes.

faq.question: What should my player bring?
faq.answer: Full pads (helmet, gloves, arm pads, shoulder pads), cleats, stick, and water.

faq.question: Do you train goalies?
faq.answer: Yes — I offer goalie-specific sessions covering positioning, save mechanics, outlet passes, and communication.
